subHeadline: Built on real data, verified by specialists, and written for owners. We don't sell cars. We don't guess. We give you the truth so you can make the right decision.

signals.title: Built on Real Data
signals.description: Every reliability rating and cost range comes from genuine UK quote and enquiry data — not manufacturer marketing, not forum guesswork.

signals.title: We Tell You When Not to Repair
signals.description: Where replacement cost exceeds what the car is worth, we say so. That's the difference between a knowledge base and a sales page.

signals.title: Vetted JLR Specialists
signals.description: Every specialist in our network is vetted specifically for Land Rover and Range Rover work — not generalists who happen to take on JLR jobs.

signals.title: Part of Engine Finders
signals.description: LandRoverEngine.uk is part of the Engine Finders family — research depth of an independent authority with a vetted route to action when you need one.

signals.title: Updated Monthly
signals.description: Enquiry volumes, cost ranges, and market insights are refreshed monthly from live UK data — not a static guide that goes stale.

signals.title: Independent Advice
signals.description: No manufacturer sponsors. No dealer bias. Just honest guidance built for Land Rover and Range Rover owners making real decisions.

commitment.title: The truth about Land Rover ownership — even when it's not what you want to hear.
commitment.text: We built this site because owners deserve straight answers. When a repair makes sense, we'll say so. When it doesn't, we'll say that too — backed by real enquiry data, not sales pressure.

image.alt: Land Rover Defender in the mountains

items.question: Where does your data come from?
items.answer: All enquiry volumes and market insights come from real UK enquiries via EnginesMarket — updated monthly and marked [EM-VERIFIED] where applicable.

items.question: How are your replacement cost ranges calculated?
items.answer: Ranges are drawn from real reconditioned and supply-only quotes across the EnginesMarket network, not manufacturer list prices or forum averages.

items.question: Do you sell engines or parts?
items.answer: No. This site is an independent ownership guide. When you need action, we can point you to vetted specialists — we don't push products.

items.question: Are your guides model and engine specific?
items.answer: Yes. Guides are organised by model, generation and engine code so the advice matches the vehicle you actually own or are considering.

items.question: How often is the information updated?
items.answer: Enquiry volumes, cost ranges and market insights are refreshed monthly from live UK data.

cta.title: Still not sure what's right for your Land Rover?
cta.text: Get specialist advice tailored to your model, engine and budget.
